query: Run the phone companion overlay capture on a connected device and review the edge glow, pointer glide, curves, rotation, ripple, and trail in the recording and contact sheets.
The Android overlay's pink screen-edge glow and inward wave are too faint. Get a composited still with the overlay visible and tell me which artifact to inspect.
The phone pointer is redirected before it settles and its path should bow with momentum. Capture the redirect scenario and verify the video evidence.
Check the Android overlay on diagonal and horizontal swipes: the pointer should sail along the path and the trail should follow rather than snap.
Inspect the Android phone-companion OverlayMath and AgentOverlayController source only to explain pointer motion and screenshot hide/restore; do not use a device or claim pixel proof.
I tuned OverlayMath's speed and turn-rate constants. Run the companion unit tests and then pick the smallest device capture that proves the motion change visually.
The companion's model screenshot hides the accessibility overlay. Help me capture the real composited phone pixels with adb screencap or screenrecord and verify hide/restore behavior.

Verify the phone pointer animation while the operator's installed daemon is active. Use the isolated release daemon/private socket and only GridTestActivity so no real app or operator state is disturbed.
What is the minimum representative Android overlay pass? Select the fewest scenarios that cover long glides, a mid-flight redirect, and trail behavior, and name the proof artifacts.

Review a phone overlay contact sheet and report one visual verdict each for edge glow, inward wave, pointer glide/curve/rotation, ripple timing, and trail direction, including the device serial and build status.
Tune the Rust/wgpu desktop cursor's smoke aura and grounding shadow, then inspect its native-resolution capture on KDE.
Use the desktop agent-cursor capture.py script and spectacle to produce a screenshot of the layer-shell pointer.
The desktop cursor's Mover2D redirect has an abrupt heading change and an early ripple; diagnose the Rust motion driver.
Fix the Android companion's login button accessibility label and verify TalkBack focus order; no overlay animation is involved.
The Android system mouse pointer is offset after rotation. Fix the platform pointer calibration, not the Codex companion overlay.
Explain the phone overlay_active and overlay_gesture RPC payloads and manager routing from source only; do not use a device or inspect pixels.
Reproduce an Android emulator login crash with adb and collect logcat; the static grid and pointer overlay are not part of the bug.
Record the phone app's splash-screen transition and make a montage of its branding animation; there is no agent pointer or edge glow to verify.
Choose a KDE Wayland screen-capture command for the whole desktop; this is unrelated to the phone companion overlay.
Run a generic Android UI screenshot regression for a settings screen and compare pixels; do not launch GridTestActivity or the agent overlay.
